scientific_integrity: Proof uses explicit digit additions and Kummer carry theorem. Empirical checks are supplementary and cannot establish an infinite claim.
scientific_limitations: Exact initial multiplier range 2<=q<=p, with known global bound used for least-attainment interpretation. The p=2 instance is prior art; earlier implicit coverage for odd primes is possible. No independent audit has occurred.
title: The missing first-power boundary for restricted binomial gcds
